snapshot.coordinateStatement: The original snapshot coordinate warning is retained as historical source metadata; the independently reproduced sequence anchors below establish the conversion used in data.csv.

coordinateEvidence.pointConversion: start0 = reportedPosition - 1; end0 = reportedPosition. Each row is one base on its source gene/RNA strand.

positiveStrand.observedPointInclusion: Neither positive-strand flank includes the reported point base at p0. The two supplied flanks leave that one-base gap.

negativeStrand.observedPointInclusion: The negative-strand upstream flank includes the reported point base at p0; the downstream flank excludes it.

coordinateEvidence.formulaConvention: p0 = reportedPosition - 1. Python-style slice bounds are zero-based and end-exclusive on the forward reference sequence.
coordinateEvidence.sourceDescriptionDiscrepancy: Table S1 field descriptions say the upstream and downstream flanks include the 3′ end. The literal sequences instead obey the asymmetric formulas above. The source strings and positions are preserved; no flank sequence is corrected.

confidence.referenceAndSequenceAnchor: high; both reference formats match and all 118 paired contexts have exactly one full-reference anchor at p0
confidence.authorPointSemantics: moderate; the source flank descriptions conflict with the observed strand-specific inclusion of the reported point base

measurementMeaning: Three source replicate counts at each selected study-curated dominant RNA 3′ end. The source integer-truncated mean and unrounded replicate mean remain audit values and are not substituted for any replicate.

replicateProvenance.countJoin: Exact reported genomic position and opposite GEO count-table strand. Every selected count triplet is read directly from the original table and reproduces the source integer-truncated mean.
replicateProvenance.scope: The available sample metadata names replicate 1. Replicates 2 and 3 retain the combined raw-table column labels; no additional accession or sample condition is inferred.

missingness.replicates: All 354 selected replicate cells are measured integers. Literal zero counts remain 0. Missing numeric values would be empty CSV cells and JSON null; absent genomic positions are not added.
missingness.optionalClassification: Missing Table S2 Rho-dependence remains an empty CSV cell and is absent in the original record. Unclassified mechanism labels are preserved.

limits: 118 curated ends below reported position 500000, not the complete study map.
Study termination classifications are preserved without inferring new mechanisms.
Predicted RNAfold structure and stability are computational source annotations, not measured folding energies.
The observed flank asymmetry supports a unique coordinate anchor but does not resolve the inconsistent author descriptions of point inclusion.
No cross-replicate normalization, read-count averaging, reference substitution or zero filling is applied.
